info.name: Grace Community Church

services.note: Traditional worship with choir. Kids programs for newborns to 5th grade.
Contemporary worship with the band. Kids programs for newborns to 5th grade. Also streamed online.
Midweek prayer and a short teaching in the chapel.

info.first_visit: Services last about 75 minutes. Come as you are; most people dress casually. Greeters at the main entrance can walk you to kids check-in and save you a seat. Free coffee is in the lobby.
info.care_team: The care team offers prayer, hospital visits, meals after a new baby or surgery, and pastoral conversations. Staff respond within one business day.

faqs.question: Where do I park?
faqs.answer: The main lot is off Maple Ridge Road. First-time guest parking is marked with green signs right by the main entrance. Overflow parking is across the street at Springfield Elementary with a shuttle every 10 minutes.

faqs.question: How does kids check-in work?
faqs.answer: Stop at the Kids Welcome desk left of the lobby. A volunteer registers your child and prints a matching name tag and pickup tag. Only the adult holding the pickup tag can collect the child.

faqs.question: Is there something for teenagers?
faqs.answer: Students in grades 6 to 12 meet Wednesdays at 6:30pm in the Student Center, and join the 11:00am Sunday service with their families.

faqs.question: Is the building accessible?
faqs.answer: Yes. All entrances are step-free, there are elevators to the balcony, reserved seating near the front, and hearing assist devices at the Welcome desk.

faqs.question: How do I become a member?
faqs.answer: Start with the Discover Grace class, offered the first Sunday of each month after the 11:00am service. It covers what the church believes and how to get involved. Lunch and childcare are provided.

faqs.question: Can I watch online?
faqs.answer: The 11:00am Sunday service streams live on the church website and stays available to watch afterward.

events.name: Discover Grace class
events.when: First Sunday of each month, 12:30pm to 2:00pm
events.description: A friendly introduction to the church, its beliefs, and how to get connected. Lunch and childcare provided.

events.name: Serve Day
events.where: Meet in the main parking lot
events.description: Teams spread out to help local schools, a food pantry, and elderly neighbors with yard work. All ages welcome.

events.name: Fall family picnic
events.description: Food trucks, games, and a bounce house. A great first event to meet people.

events.name: Volunteer training: Welcome team
events.description: A 45-minute training for new greeters and guest services volunteers.

events.name: Worship night
events.description: An evening of music and prayer led by the worship collective.

groups.name: Young adults

groups.name: Parents of little ones

groups.name: Men's breakfast
